introduction: Minnesota 211 connects callers with community resources around the clock. The service is free and confidential.
description: Minnesota 211 connects callers with community resources around the clock. The service is free and confidential.

sections.who: Anyone looking for Minnesota resources can request referrals. Each provider has its own intake rules.
sections.get: Navigators help locate food, housing, utility and other support. A referral does not reserve funding.

sections.apply:
1. Contact 211

    Dial 211 or 800-543-7709, or text your ZIP code to 898211.

  2. Ask for a useful referral

    Describe the need and ask which providers are currently accepting applications.

  3. Contact the provider

    Use Minnesota 211 to search further resources.
sections.after: Confirm appointment hours, required records and availability with the provider.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Minnesota 211 services. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
